def VTask.subtypePreimage {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := by
  have h_main : { x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a : α // ¬p a } → β) := by
    constructor
    · -- Prove the forward direction: { x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } → ({ a : α // ¬p a } → β)
      intro ⟨x, hx⟩
      -- Define y : { a : α // ¬p a } → β by y ⟨a, ha⟩ = x a
      refine' ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x a, _⟩
      -- Prove that the constructed y satisfies the required properties
      <;> simp_all [Function.funext_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]
      <;> aesop
    · -- Prove the backward direction: ({ a : α // ¬p a } → β) → { x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }
      intro y
      -- Define x : α → β by cases on p a
      refine' ⟨fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by simpa using h⟩, _⟩
      -- Prove that x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀
      ext ⟨a, ha⟩
      -- Consider the cases p a and ¬p a
      by_cases h : p a <;> simp_all [Subtype.val_mk]
      <;> aesop
  
  exact h_main
